# Shining Legacy Commercial Cleaning Inc.

> Commercial cleaning company based in Durham Region, Ontario, Canada, serving the Greater Toronto Area (Toronto, Mississauga, Brampton, Etobicoke, Vaughan, Markham), Durham Region (Oshawa, Whitby, Ajax, Pickering) and Clarington (Bowmanville, Courtice, Newcastle). Services: office cleaning, janitorial services, medical office cleaning, post-construction cleaning, condo and building common-area cleaning, retail cleaning, warehouse and industrial cleaning. Insured and bonded, WHMIS-compliant, eco-friendly products. Free quote within 24 hours.

- Phone: (437) 781-1769
- Email: info@shininglegacy.ca
- Hours: Monday–Friday and Sunday, 10:00–18:00 (Eastern)
- Typical pricing: most GTA office cleaning contracts range from $300 to $1,500 per month depending on size, frequency and facility type.
